## 证明

**第一步：识别模数。**

令 $k = x = \frac{\sqrt{6}+\sqrt{2}}{4} = \cos\frac{\pi}{12}$。则
$$k^2 = \cos^2\frac{\pi}{12} = \frac{1+\cos(\pi/6)}{2} = \frac{2+\sqrt{3}}{4}, \qquad k'^2 = 1-k^2 = \frac{2-\sqrt{3}}{4}.$$

因此
$$k' = \sqrt{\frac{2-\sqrt{3}}{4}} = \frac{\sqrt{3}-1}{2\sqrt{2}} = \frac{\sqrt{6}-\sqrt{2}}{4} = \sin\frac{\pi}{12}.$$

**第二步：识别奇异模数。**

$\tau = i\sqrt{3}$ 对应的经典奇异模数 $k_3$ 满足 $\lambda(i\sqrt{3}) = k_3^2$。已知
$$k_3 = \frac{\sqrt{3}-1}{2\sqrt{2}}, \qquad \text{即 } k_3^2 = \frac{2-\sqrt{3}}{4}.$$

因此 $k' = k_3$，且 $k = k_3'$（$k_3$ 的补模数）。根据定义，
$$\frac{K(k_3')}{K(k_3)} = \sqrt{3}.$$

**第三步：应用 $K(k_3)$ 的经典值。**

Chowla–Selberg 公式给出了 $n=3$ 时的值：
$$K(k_3) = \frac{3^{1/4}\,\Gamma^3\!\left(\tfrac{1}{3}\right)}{2^{7/3}\,\pi}.$$

（数值验证：$\Gamma(1/3)\approx 2.6789$，因此 $K(k_3) \approx \frac{1.3161 \times 19.22}{5.040 \times 3.1416} \approx 1.598$，与 $K(0.2588)\approx 1.598$ 一致。）

因此
$$K(k) = K(k_3') = \sqrt{3}\,K(k_3) = \sqrt{3}\cdot\frac{3^{1/4}\,\Gamma^3\!\left(\tfrac{1}{3}\right)}{2^{7/3}\,\pi} = \frac{3^{3/4}\,\Gamma^3\!\left(\tfrac{1}{3}\right)}{2^{7/3}\,\pi}.$$

**第四步：计算所求比值。**

$$\frac{K(x)\,\pi}{2^{-7/3}\,3^{3/4}\,\Gamma^3\!\left(\tfrac{1}{3}\right)} = \frac{\dfrac{3^{3/4}\,\Gamma^3\!\left(\tfrac{1}{3}\right)}{2^{7/3}\,\pi}\cdot\pi}{2^{-7/3}\,3^{3/4}\,\Gamma^3\!\left(\tfrac{1}{3}\right)} = \frac{2^{-7/3}\,3^{3/4}\,\Gamma^3\!\left(\tfrac{1}{3}\right)}{2^{-7/3}\,3^{3/4}\,\Gamma^3\!\left(\tfrac{1}{3}\right)} = 1.$$

该比值为 $\boxed{1}$。
